resources.string: Detects which app is in the foreground during a focus session so Flowstate can send you back to your work. It never reads screen content.
The running session in a ring: subject, live time, round, and stop, pause and skip.
A slim bar with the current subject, round, when your break starts and the live time.
Start a 25 min Pomodoro, 50 min of deep work, a stopwatch or a 5 min break in one tap.
Days to your next exam and how much of its syllabus is done.
Today\'s focused time, daily goal progress, sessions, streak and this week\'s focus.
Your current and best streak, and the last four weeks shaded by focus time.
Up to four tasks for today. Tick them off right from the home screen.
Who in your group is focusing right now, on what, and for how long.
Progress per subject for the exam picked on the Syllabus tab, and what is up next.
Your break counting down with a tip, Skip break and pause. Start a 5 min break when idle.
